sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: The Tribunal sits in benches, and a bench is ordinarily constituted by two Members, one Judicial and one Technical.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A single Member may dispose of the matters the section permits. A difference of opinion is referred as the section states. The principal bench sits at New Delhi.
